description: A photograph depicting a rural landscape characterized by a mix of agricultural features and natural vegetation within a valley setting. In the foreground, from left to right, are a "FRUIT TREE", "GRASSES" along the ground, a low stone wall, a patch of "ARABLE LAND" indicated by a white arrow, more "GRASSES", and an "OLIVE TREE". The mid-ground and background show dense natural vegetation covering hillsides, with a winding river visible in the valley bottom. The image illustrates land cover class 2.3.3, "Land principally occupied by agriculture with significant areas of natural vegetation," which encompasses parcels of annual cropland, permanent crops, and natural/semi-natural vegetation (forest, groups of trees, shrub, small water bodies) all mixed together, typically with parcels under 0.5 ha.
